'''Brandon Im''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Virginia Beach tournament]] on 5 November 2000 with [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Rebel Strike Team]], according to Brian Catalino's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1424">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-virginia-beach-va-11-5-2000d1424/ virginia-beach-va-11-5-2000], DeckTech (brian "darkjedi2000" catalino, 6 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-06-virginia-beach-va-11-5-2000d1424/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
